issues.on_page: County Treasurer - other state receipts, function code 3180, 75,590
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: detail[1] set to category Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate, detail_category motor vehicle pro-rate] The General Fund line prints only code 3180 (Pro-Rate Motor Vehicle). Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate is its own category and is never inside state aid; it should be category Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate, detail_category motor vehicle pro-rate.

issues.on_page: County Treasurer - other state receipts, codes 3130-3180, 901,141
issues.issue: This line combines homestead (3130), property tax credit and pro-rate MV (3180). The rule keeps such lines in state aid but with a review note, and none is set. Same for detail[50] (Special Building, 1,399,152, p10).

The schedule prints no split. It was inferred from the p4 Other Governmental Funds column (Pupils 40,194, Summer school 3,165), which ties but is not a printed breakdown of this line. The 90,000 budget is dropped. Same for detail[63].
The category is Extracurricular Receipts (student fees), but detail_category is 'tuition and fees'. 'student activity receipts' would be consistent.
